 Mangane Priyanka Updated on 18 Nov 2026, 10:06 AM IST 
 The Himachal Pradesh School Education Board, Dharamshala, released the HPBOSE 3rd, 5th, 8th class winter closing exam date sheet on November 16, 2026. The HP Board Class 3 and 5 exams will be held from December 14 to 18, 2026, while the HPBOSE Class 8 exams will be held from December 9 to 19, 2026. The board will conduct the HPBOSE Classes 3, 5, and 8 exams from 9:45 am to 1 pm.

2026 Question Papers HPBOSE 2026 Exam Day Guidelines
 Candidates are advised to go through the guidelines mentioned while appearing for the examination.
 The board will not provide the question papers marked with a Star. Instead, schools will prepare themselves, and the exam will be conducted accordingly.
 The question papers will be allotted to students at 9:45 am. Candidates can read the question paper in this extra time and enter the necessary details on the answer sheet.
 Students should write the same question number on the answer sheet as on the question paper while answering the questions.
 The HP Board examination will start at 10 am only.
 Candidates are advised to listen to the instructions given by the invigilators.
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: When will the HPBOSE 8th Class exams be held? A: Schools affiliated with the Himachal Pradesh Board will conduct the Class 8 winter vacation closing exams from December 9 to 19, 2026.
 Q: What are the timings for the HP Board Classes 3, 5, and 8 winter closing examinations? A: The HPBOSE will conduct the 3rd, 5th, and 8th class exams from 9:45 am to 1 pm.
 Q: Where can I download the HP Board 3rd, 5th, and 8th exam timetable for 2026-27? A: Students can visit the official website at hpbose.org to access and download the HP Board exam datesheet 2026-27 for Classes 3, 5, and 8.
